sources.tmy: PVGIS-SARAH2 typical meteorological year 2005-2020 (EU JRC): irradiance from SARAH-2, air temperature, humidity, wind, long-wave and pressure from ERA5; unobstructed (horizon applied per point by the script)
sources.horizon: PVGIS horizon profiles from DEM (EU JRC): every 100 m on a grid over the frame and 300 m around it (interpolated between nodes); 18 profiles kept for frames beyond it
sources.lst: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface temperature (USGS), via Microsoft Planetary Computer
sources.trees: Meta / WRI 1 m global canopy height map (Tolan et al. 2024, Remote Sens. Environ.); crowns from canopy-height maxima. Leaf type: Copernicus CLC+ Backbone 2021 (EEA, 10 m) under the crown, else the crown's own Sentinel-2 NDVI seasonality 2019-2025, else the nearest CLC+ tree pixel. Deciduous leaf-out and leaf-fall days: Sentinel-2 2019-2025 NDVI of the CLC+ deciduous pixels (double-logistic fit, 50 % of the seasonal amplitude)

winter.note: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 surface temperature (band 10), USGS; 100 m thermal resampled to 30 m

spring.note: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 surface temperature (band 10), USGS; 100 m thermal resampled to 30 m

summer.note: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 surface temperature (band 10), USGS; 100 m thermal resampled to 30 m

autumn.note: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 surface temperature (band 10), USGS; 100 m thermal resampled to 30 m

tmy_meta.source: PVGIS 5.2 TMY (EU JRC), PVGIS-SARAH2 radiation, ERA5 weather, 2005-2020
tmy_meta.note: irradiance at the time stamp + tmy_offset_h (satellite time); weather at the time stamp (UTC)

spring.note: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface temperature (band 10, USGS) via Planetary Computer; mean of every scene of the season with at least 95 % of the grid clear (QA_PIXEL); 100 m thermal resampled to 30 m

summer.note: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface temperature (band 10, USGS) via Planetary Computer; mean of every scene of the season with at least 95 % of the grid clear (QA_PIXEL); 100 m thermal resampled to 30 m

autumn.note: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface temperature (band 10, USGS) via Planetary Computer; mean of every scene of the season with at least 95 % of the grid clear (QA_PIXEL); 100 m thermal resampled to 30 m

winter.note: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface temperature (band 10, USGS) via Planetary Computer; mean of every scene of the season with at least 95 % of the grid clear (QA_PIXEL); 100 m thermal resampled to 30 m

horizon_grid.note: profiles h[j][i] at frame-local (u0 + i du, v0 + j du), azimuth 0 = north, 7.5 deg steps

phenology.source: Sentinel-2 L2A (ESA Copernicus, via Microsoft Planetary Computer) 2019-2025, NDVI of the CLC+ Backbone 2021 broadleaved deciduous pixels with a canopy share of at least 0.3, unmixed from their canopy-free surroundings; double-logistic fit over the day of the year, dates at 50 % of the seasonal amplitude

leaf_src.1: CLC+ Backbone 2021 tree class under the crown
leaf_src.2: the crown's own Sentinel-2 NDVI seasonality 2019-2025 (unmixed)
